mapper.select: SELECT i.itemid, i.listprice, i.unitcost, i.supplier AS supplierId, i.status, i.attr1 AS attribute1, i.attr2 AS attribute2, i.attr3 AS attribute3, i.attr4 AS attribute4, i.attr5 AS attribute5, p.productid AS "product.productId", p.name AS "product.name", p.descn AS "product.description", p.category AS "product.categoryId" FROM item i INNER JOIN product p ON p.productid = i.productid WHERE i.productid = #{productId}

SELECT i.itemid, i.listprice, i.unitcost, i.supplier AS supplierId, i.status, i.attr1 AS attribute1, i.attr2 AS attribute2, i.attr3 AS attribute3, i.attr4 AS attribute4, i.attr5 AS attribute5, v.qty AS quantity, p.productid AS "product.productId", p.name AS "product.name", p.descn AS "product.description", p.category AS "product.categoryId" FROM item i INNER JOIN product p ON p.productid = i.productid INNER JOIN inventory v ON v.itemid = i.itemid WHERE i.itemid = #{itemId}
SELECT qty FROM inventory WHERE itemid = #{itemId}
